adjudication.rationale: In `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent`, the calendarId is now chosen via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` and falls back to `"primary"` when no match is found. In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, the no-`credentialId` branch (`destination.credentialId` falsy) calls `createEvent(c, event)` for credentials of the matching integration without passing any externalId override, and the `destinationCalendar` entries in that path have `credentialId` null/undefined. That means Google calendar creation will not match any destination entry and will create the event on the credential's primary calendar instead of the configured `destination.externalId`. The finding’s specific claim that CalendarManager/refs still store `destination.externalId` in this no-credentialId path is not directly supported (the new `externalId` is only passed when `destination.credentialId` exists), but the core behavior regression (wrong calendar selection for no-credentialId destinations) is verifiable from the diff.
